evidence_boundary: The committed file declares the matrix and deterministic identities expected from the current native candidate. Native file review runs with page JavaScript disabled and rejects any executable script element; axe-core necessarily uses a separate JavaScript-enabled, CSP-bypassed instrumentation context over the same digest-checked local file, with HTTP and HTTPS blocked. Axe-core provides an automated ruleset evaluation, not full WCAG certification or a substitute for assistive-technology testing. A current hosted run against the PR head is required before T-13 is accepted; this file alone and the historical original-review2 browser report are not execution evidence.
